verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that node_modules files are hard links to a single content-addressable store, so 'a hundred projects on the same version cost you one copy on disk.' Community users independently report dramatically reduced disk usage and a smaller cache, and praise `pnpm store prune` for store maintenance. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence on configuring the store (location/store-dir) and on how hard-linking behaves across separate drives or filesystems.
